_comment: E2E-only gateway config (Playwright `my-tokens` project, port 3003). requireAuthForApi mounts the session-cookie middleware on /api so that POST /auth/dev-login (a *user* principal, type=user) authenticates subsequent /api calls — letting PAT management (which rejects non-user principals) be exercised end-to-end. No OIDC providers, so the login screen still offers the dev 'Enter as Admin' button. authorization stays disabled so the principal is treated as admin.
